description: Get instant answers about how Alhena AI helps ecommerce brands win AI search, convert shoppers, and deflect support tickets, grounded in Alhena's docs, pricing, blog, and case studies. Explore the Shopping Concierge, Support Concierge, AEO, voice, and agent assist, see which helpdesks and storefronts it integrates with (Shopify, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Intercom, and more), and estimate ROI from verified customer results. Hallucination-free, and faster than clicking through the site page by page.
